notes.title: Switch Release Discount, 10% Celebration Sale on Steam
notes.notes:
In order to celebrate the release of "Zebulon: A Lost Cat" on Nintendo Switch platform we decided it was cool to discount it by 10% on Steam too. 

Now you can enjoy Zebulon on the go. Don't forget It runs nicely on Steam Deck too, by the way !

Have fun !

notes.title: Update Notes Version 1.2 08/12/2024
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] New in-game Medals system! Collect all 9 Medals, each one being a challenge (9 lives, minit speedrun...) A new screen lets you know about it on your first completion of the game 
[*] Now multiple achievements / Medals can be collected in one run, providing the conditions are met 
[*] SteamInput : Default configuration now binds all face buttons to Jump & Dash (adding X & Y to the mapping by default) 
[*] Fix inputs not behaving properly when on a low-end machine 
[*] Fix potential framerate issues on a low-end machine 
[*] Change power-up sprite to be more distinguishable from the key sprite 
[*] Music doesn’t stop in the options menu anymore 
[/list]
If you have any issue (bug, performance, ...) let us know in the “Bugs & Technical Issues” section of the Discussions in the Community Hub
